2. Make the second deal take half the time of the first.
3. Review the flywheel quarterly, not the tiers.

The article's headline result is that fabrikam-example's second-deal cycle fell from 74 days to 31 days in a year after it switched to artifact bonuses.

I stored the full text unchanged, with the blog URL and a source line pointing to `notes/article-partner-flywheels.md`. I didn't add any commentary or links to other pages.
